mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which reduces discount rates for equity valuations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 4.0% (t-test p>0.05 vs. baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A high unemployment rate (UNRATE > 5.0%) signals labor market weakness and reduced consumer spending, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE exceeds 5.0% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.0%) and rising interest rates (FEDFUNDS > 4.5%) trigger a hawkish monetary policy response, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both CPIAUCSL > 3.0 and FEDFUNDS > 4.5 (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO < 110.0) indicates a manufacturing slowdown, which typically precedes economic weakness and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 110.0 (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: High housing starts (HOUST > 1500.0) reflect strong consumer demand and economic activity, which supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST exceeds 1500.0 (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) signals central bank tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Weak job growth (PAYEMS < 100k) combined with declining retail sales (RSAFS < 370000) indicates a deteriorating consumer economy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances where both PAYEMS < 100 and RSAFS < 370000 (t-test p>0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment (UNRATE increasing by >0.2% in 3 months) signals labor market deterioration, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE rises by more than 0.2 percentage points in 3 months (t-test p>0.05).
